name: World
description: Brings the outside world in for a query: a web search through the selected search arm and, for research questions, the papers of the world-knowing seat. Returns an answer with the sources a reader can check.
purpose: Connect any AI to tools, search and data sources without writing code for each one.
approach: Admit tools and data sources through narrow interfaces and compare each candidate on the same tasks.
milestones: 1. The offline stage of metric-take-in-the-world has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 2. The staged stage of metric-take-in-the-world has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 3. The whole stage of metric-take-in-the-world has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 4. The selected arm is the one the cascade of metric-take-in-the-world chooses (rule S33).
measures_of_success: Task pass rate and cost per passing task, per hub.
outputs: Outside material for a task, from the search backends.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: The Self
description: The integration, coherence and role understanding of all the parts: the whole that keeps Body, Intelligence, World and Consciousness working as one, and answers a request by handing it to the Assembler.
purpose: Keep every part of an AI system working as one coherent whole, for anyone who assembles one from the hub.
approach: Compose Integrity, Role Understanding, the Assembler and Model Plumbing, and let the other four containers be built on them.
milestones: 1. The whole answers a real request as one capable assistant (metric-the-self).
measures_of_success: The whole answers a real request as one capable assistant.
outputs: The answer of the assembled hub, with the arms used.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("the-self", "what is the latest Rust release?")`; the same call as `hubofhubs.run("hub-of-hubs", ...)`.

name: Body
description: The AI system's form and internal context: it makes it easy to apply the hub to a particular system by providing adapters or declaring the system's internal APIs, databases and local files.
purpose: Let any product give the AI its own form and context without rewriting the hub's parts.
approach: Compose Internal Context, Learning, Nervous System, Hands and Acting, and let a system declare what is its own.
milestones: 1. A system declares its own sources and acts through the hub without code written for each part (metric-the-body).
measures_of_success: A system declares its own sources and acts through the hub without code written for each part.
outputs: A system's own context, risk signal, integrations and actions, through the hub's interfaces.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Intelligence
description: The processing of information: what the AI sees for one request, how it answers, how it holds the answer to its evidence and how it keeps the long view.
purpose: Answer each request from what bears on it, at the lowest cost that still passes.
approach: Compose Mind, Higher Mind, Subconscious and Critical Thinking, with one intake for the Mind that two sources feed.
milestones: 1. One request is answered from the information that bears on it and no more (metric-the-intelligence).
measures_of_success: One request is answered from the information that bears on it and no more.
outputs: An answer, plan or communication for one request, held to its evidence.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Consciousness
description: The humans who interact with the system: AI representatives that learn, for each person, when to ask and when not to, and act as that person wants from the person's feedback.
purpose: Let the system adapt to each human it works with, so people are neither interrupted needlessly nor surprised.
approach: Compose Representatives, Asking Judgment and Feedback Learning, on one signal contract with the Nervous System.
milestones: 1. A representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked and acts as the person wants (metric-the-consciousness).
measures_of_success: A representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked and acts as the person wants.
outputs: A decision to ask, proceed or decline for one person, and behaviour that follows that person's feedback.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.
